headline: 无 GPU、8 GB 内存可跑本地大模型，编程代理同时补上代码图谱、审美技能和更短回复。
headlineEn: CPU-only machines with 8 GB of RAM can host a local model, while coding agents add codebase graphs, visual taste, and shorter replies.

lead.name: opensetlabs/openset-llm
lead.zh: README 称 8 GB 纯 CPU 可跑 27B，约 17 到 20 token 每秒，约为所测次快引擎的四倍。
lead.en: An OpenAI-compatible server with no GPU. The README says a 27B model reaches 17–20 tokens per second on eight cores and 8 GB of RAM, about four times the next engine they tested.
lead.why: 每天把上下文交给 Claude 和编程代理的人，现在可以在没有显卡的机器上起一个兼容接口的本地模型，把一部分推理留在自己这边。
lead.whyEn: If you already send context to Claude and coding agents, you can stand up an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a machine with no GPU and keep some inference at home.

sections.title: 编程代理要图谱、审美和更短回复
sections.titleEn: Coding agents want graphs, taste, and fewer tokens

items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.zh: 把代码库连同文档与 SQL 谱成可查询知识图谱，边由本地 AST 解析，不靠向量库。
items.en: Turn a repo, its docs, SQL, and configs into a local graph with explained edges, then reuse that context in Claude Code or Cursor without a vector store.

items.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.zh: 艺术指导、参考图和浏览器核对，用来约束代理做出的页面。
items.en: Skills that steer coding agents with art direction, reference images, and a browser pass instead of generic layouts.

items.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.zh: 作者称在 Terminal-Bench 上每道解出的题比 Codex 少花百分之二十一的费用。
items.en: A skill and local proxy that shortens replies and tool traces while keeping the original recoverable. The authors say it cost 21% less than Codex per solved Terminal-Bench task.

items.name: NEXUS
items.zh: 在本地画代码地图，模型只改你已经批准的部分。
items.en: Build a local map of the repo, and the model may edit only the changes you already signed off on.

items.name: WhipDesk
items.zh: 手机上遥控人工智能编程代理。
items.en: Drive coding agents from a phone when you are away from the desk.

sections.title: 留在本机的代理与记录
sections.titleEn: Agents and notes that stay on the machine

items.name: simplexai-labs/linger
items.zh: 开源个人代理，完全跑在自己的电脑上。
items.en: A personal agent meant to run entirely on your PC, so the session does not have to live on someone else's servers.

items.name: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
items.zh: 会议纪要留在本机，通话里不出现机器人，覆盖 Mac、Windows 与 Linux。
items.en: Meeting notes transcribed on your computer, with no bot joining the call, on Mac, Windows, and Linux.

items.name: sybil-solutions/inference-optimisation-skill
items.zh: 针对本地大模型服务速度做爬山：解码、推测解码、预填充、缓存与首字延迟。
items.en: A skill that hill-climbs local LLM serving across decode, speculative decode, prefill, KV, startup, and time to first token.

items.name: Meboki
items.zh: 离线语法检查，可在任意 Mac 应用中使用，并且开源。
items.en: Grammar checking that stays offline and works inside whatever Mac app you are typing in.

sections.title: 代理如何看见网站与外部知识
sections.titleEn: How agents see sites and outside knowledge

items.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.zh: 搜索、抓取，并经同一接口接上五百五十多家数据源，当作代理的知识层。
items.en: Search, scrape, and reach more than 550 data providers through one API, as knowledge plumbing for agents.

items.name: Bifura
items.zh: 从代理的视角查看你的网站。
items.en: Preview how agents parse your pages, not how a browser paints them.
